original_question: For the lattice of Young diagrams with at most r rows, the general differential-poset theory yields an RSK-type correspondence from r-colored permutations into pairs of tableaux with suitable weighting. Can this theory be extended to include a notion of jeu de taquin for these diagrams and a Greene invariant for r-colored permutations that groups together exactly the permutations producing the same insertion tableau?
target_in_paper: Section 2, Problem 4 (Problems of 2025): the open problem asking whether the RSK theory for the differential lattice of Young diagrams with at most r rows can be extended by a jeu de taquin and by a Greene invariant for r-colored permutations.

refined_question: Fix a positive integer r. For the differential lattice of Young diagrams with at most r rows, Fomin’s general theory yields an RSK algorithm from the associated r-colored permutations to weighted pairs of corresponding tableaux. In close analogy with the classical theories for ordinary and shifted Young diagrams, can one extend this r-row theory by defining (i) a jeu de taquin for these tableaux and (ii) a Greene-type invariant for those r-colored permutations whose equivalence classes are exactly the sets of permutations having the same insertion tableau P?

The neighboring problem on the same family of diagrams is Problem 6, but that one is about limit shapes, not insertion-tableau fibers or Greene theory, so it is not the intended target.
